carla: Quick summary from today's staged bring-up for r2026-03-int8 — ran A/B on ~10k user prompts, 3% live traffic.
carla: Key numbers: p50 latency 68ms -> 48ms (-29%), p95 210ms -> 160ms (-24%), estimated per-token infra cost -18%.
carla: Quality: Rouge-L avg down 1.2% absolute, hallucination flag rate up 0.5pp (0.6% -> 1.1%), QA-exact drop 0.4pp on our eval slice.
carla: Notable: degraded examples concentrated in long-context summarization and liability/legal prompts (small slice but high risk).

deploy-bot: Canaried r2026-03-int8 to 3% at 1728001200. Monitor channels: eng-ml, incidents.

ben: thanks. is the 1.2% Rouge-L drop across the whole eval or driven by that legal slice?
carla: mostly driven by two slices: long-summary and legal. If you remove those, global drop ~0.3%.

dave: That suggests we can proceed with targeted mitigations instead of full rollback. Options: patch prompt templates for legal slice OR keep previous model for that traffic via routing rule.

eva: Agreed. Proposal: gating rule should be multi-signal and slice-aware. If overall quality delta > -0.5% persist for 2 consecutive windows OR any high-risk slice delta > -0.3% for a single window, auto-fallback.

ben: I like multi-signal. Also require latency improvement >= 10% to qualify for promotion; otherwise cost/quality tradeoff not worth it.

carla: Draft gating YAML (for discussion):

```
promote_policy:
  stable_windows: 3
  window_interval: 30m
  overall_metrics:
    - name: rouge_l
      delta_threshold: -0.5
      comparator: absolute
    - name: qa_exact
      delta_threshold: -0.5
      comparator: absolute
  slice_rules:
    - name: legal
      delta_threshold: -0.3
      severity: high
    - name: long_summary
      delta_threshold: -0.5
      severity: medium
  latency_min_improvement_pct: 10
  auto_fallback:
    enabled: true
    trigger: any   # any rule breach triggers immediate rollback
    cooldown: 1h
```

frank-sre: small ops note — if auto-fallback triggers, ensure traffic shifts to previous variant gracefully (ramp over 60s) and drain sessions. Add alert to oncall.

dave: Also recommend a shadow-run for the legal slice with gold prompts to collect more signals; we should run n=5k examples before re-promote.

eva: Can we add a 'degradation-slope' guard? e.g., if metric delta is worsening across two windows even if below thresholds, block promote.

carla: Yes — add slope detection. Action items: 1) hold promotion at 3% until we run targeted shadow on legal slice (assigned: dave). 2) ops to add graceful rollback ramp (frank-sre). 3) I will open a PR to add the YAML gating + slope check and a playbook entry for this class of regressions.

ben: :thumbsup: good plan. if dave's shadow data looks clean after 5k examples and slope is flat, we can step to 10% then 25% with 30m windows.

frank-sre: will add alert and rollback runbook to oncall wiki.

carla: tagging @ben @dave @eva for visibility. I'll update this thread when shadow results are in. Thanks all.

ben: ack.

frank-sre: noted.

carla: (internal note) Also let's add a behavioral test in preflight that exercises legal-style long prompts — caught early next time.
